column1: # *** THE DEATH NOTICE OF ROBERT PAUL LERENA, 1950. ***
# Read 16 September 2026, from a photograph in David's own files.
# *** THIS IS THE DOCUMENT THIS ARCHIVE HAS BEEN CHASING SINCE IT BEGAN. ***
# It is the estate file KAB MOOC 6/9/17017, reference 1847/50, at the Western Cape Archives, and
# there has been an open errand requesting it - status "sent" - for over a week. On the morning of
# 16 September 2026 this archive called it "the single most valuable file in this entire archive,
# because it asks for HIS parents - the one document that could name Juan Carlos Lerena."
# It was on the disk the whole time. And it answers.

column3: note

column2: DEATH NOTICE, pursuant to the provisions contained in "The Administration of Estates Act, 1913"
column3: Printed form, E.W. (Pty) Ltd. Annotated at the head 1847/50 and 28-4-1950.
Not Pablo Armando. The Cape buried him under the English name.
*** NATIONALITY ONLY. No town, no province. The notice does not say Rosario. ***
*** THE ANSWER, AND IT IS A NULL. ***
*** THE ANSWER, AND IT IS A NULL. ***

*** A TEN-YEAR DISCREPANCY, AND IT IS NOT SMOOTHED. *** His passport and his enrolment card both give 22 February 1882, which makes him 68 at death. This says 77, and the informant wrote "approx" beside it in her own hand. She did not know his parents' names either. It is an estimate by a woman who was not his family, and the archive keeps 1882 - but it records the 77.
Agrees with the 1940 passport. Thirty-nine years after "horse-dealer" on the marriage register.
*** NONE. He did not marry Rose Lilian Theys, whatever the family believed. ***

column2: *** Mary Septima Lerena born Taylor - died in 1935 ***
column3: Agrees with 15 November 1935.
Agrees with Wynberg, 3 September 1911.

column2: House No. 7 Forth Road, Newlands, District Cape
column3: *** The same address as the executrix in the liquidation account. ***

column2: *** Roque Luis Armando Lerena; Ricardo Juan Carlos Lerena; Nuno Fernando Lerena - all majors ***
column3: Three sons, no daughters. Agrees with the 1950 liquidation account.
He had no children by any other marriage - so Careen Maria Lerena, the 1947 infant in his grave, is not acknowledged here.
Dated 6 February 1942, per the liquidation account.
Rose Lilian Theys
She was in the room when he died. In the liquidation account she is described as a spinster of No. 7 Forth Road - the same house - and "no relation".

column1: # The one document in the world that was required by law to name Pablo Armando's father and mother
# The informant was not family. She was the woman he lived with, who was present at his death and
# whom he made his executrix, and she could not name his parents. *** Nor could any of his three
# living adult sons, who did not supply the information either. *** Cheryl Defranceski wrote to her
# English cousin in 2020: "My Father never discussed his parents with me or my siblings so we never
# knew anything about either of them." That silence is seventy years old and it is now dated: it
# *** SO THE 1908 ARGENTINE ENROLMENT CARD REMAINS THE ONLY DOCUMENT ON EARTH THAT NAMES JUAN
# CARLOS LERENA AND MARIA LERENA. *** Everything this archive does from here rests on one card
# filed in a drawer in Buenos Aires, and on nothing else.
# *** AND ONE ERRAND CAN BE CLOSED. *** The request to the Western Cape Archives for this death
# notice is answered. What is still worth having from MOOC 6/9/17017 is the WILL of 6 February 1942
# and the inventory - not the death notice.
# *** AND THERE IS A SECOND 1950 DOCUMENT, WHICH IS NOT THE SAME THING. ***
# Read 16 September 2026 from the same folder: the UNION OF SOUTH AFRICA DEATH CERTIFICATE,
# A 214036, registered in the district of WYNBERG, Cape of Good Hope, entry W612/50.
# A death NOTICE is filed by the family for the Master. A death CERTIFICATE is the civil
# registration. They disagree, and both disagree with the passport.

column3: *** LERINA on the civil register - the spelling this archive has treated as a clerk's slip, and here it is on the death certificate itself. ***
Against "77 approx" on the notice and against 68 implied by the passport's 22 February 1882.
Vaguer even than the notice's "Argentine". No country, no town.
The notice says Racehorse Trainer; the passport says Trainer; the 1911 marriage says horse-dealer.

column2: *** Coronary Thrombosis; Angina Pectoris. Duration: 6 weeks; about 3 years. ***
column3: *** A cause of death this archive did not have. *** His son Nuno died of a coronary thrombosis at forty-six, twenty-one years later.
The same Dr J. R. E. Lee whose bill for professional services appears in the 1950 liquidation account.

*** THIS CONTRADICTS THE FAMILY. *** Cheryl was told by the Newlands cemetery office that he, Mary Septima and an infant lie there. The certificate names MAITLAND as the intended place of burial. Intended is not actual - but one of the two is wrong and neither has been checked against a burial register.

column2: *** W. Fraser, of Main Road, Observatory. Qualification: "Causing burial". ***
column3: *** AN UNDERTAKER. *** So the death notice was completed by a woman of no relation and the death certificate by the undertaker. *** Not one document at his death was filled in by anybody who knew where he came from. ***
